model_scope: General migration dynamics; country-level destination attractiveness and next-year national net-migration outcome; Tech MBA remains optional scenario only
model_status: Equal-weight EOM baseline scored; empirical model remains uncalibrated; chronological backtest completed
energy_equation_reference: E_i = -z(GDPpc_PPP) + z(price_level_ratio) - z(regulatory_quality) - z(-unemployment) - z(government_effectiveness) - z(political_stability); lower energy = stronger attractor. English: energy equals minus income proxy plus price-level proxy minus regulatory quality minus job-opportunity proxy minus government effectiveness minus political stability.
parameter_status: Equal weights are a transparent baseline, not estimated parameters. Ridge comparator fitted separately inside expanding-origin folds; not adopted as EOM weights.
training_data_snapshot: User-supplied World Bank WDI workbook; 171,299 nonmissing rows across 16 indicators, 265 country/aggregate codes, 1960-2024; model excludes WDI rows lacking country region classification.
training_period: Chronological target years 1997-2022 across folds; scored target years 1999, 2001, 2003-2023 with gaps where target coverage is insufficient.
evaluation_status: Expanding-origin backtest completed: 4,005 country-year predictions, 177 countries, 23 scored target years. Ridge MAE 6.081 vs country-mean 3.963 and persistence 2.438. Mean within-year Spearman: EOM attraction 0.402, Ridge 0.446, persistence 0.871.
change_summary: Ingested user-supplied WDI Excel export; generated long-format source panel and indicator metadata; calculated first 2023 equal-weight ranking for 19 focus destinations; excluded WDI aggregates from country-level evaluation; ran chronological expanding-origin benchmark and ±20% weight sensitivity analysis; logged UK HC 584 rule update.
limitations: Uncalibrated macro proxies: GDP per capita PPP is not wages; PPP price-level ratio is not housing affordability; unemployment is not labour demand; WGI scores are estimates. Country-level net migration is heterogeneous and noisy. Equal-weight EOM rank correlation is below persistence; Ridge MAE is worse than simple baselines. No causal effects identified.

change_summary: Added India as 20th global comparator; reran ranking and chronological backtest on existing merged panel; reran 6 unit tests; updated policy evidence with sourced 2026 developments; created 20-destination coverage matrix and forecast-ledger status.
limitations: No fresh raw ZIP ingestion this run; exact publication date of uploaded WDI CSV vintage unverified. GDP per capita PPP is not wage; price-level ratio is not housing affordability; unemployment is not occupation-level demand. Four governance/cost series are legacy-vintage and stop in 2023. Country-year national net migration is not origin-destination flow; EOM is not calibrated or causally validated.
